unit: EUR bn, calendar years; + adds to the deficit
note: Spain has had no new budget law since 2023 (the 2023 budget is rolled over). Legislated multi-year changes are the pension reform's rising contributions (RDL 2/2023) and the 2026 energy-crisis decree-laws.

items.label: Pension reform: rising MEI and solidarity contributions
items.head: tax
items.source: AIReF, Informe de seguimiento del Plan Fiscal y Estructural de Medio Plazo: the two contributions add 0.4pp a year to social-contribution growth until 2029, about EUR 0.7bn a year on 2025's EUR 175.6bn (as reported by El Independiente, May 2026)

items.label: 2026 energy response: fuel, electricity and gas tax cuts
items.head: tax
items.event: RDL 7/2026 and subsequent energy RDLs (Middle East price response)
items.source: AIReF: temporary energy / disaster / Ceuta measures lift the 2026 deficit by ~0.9pp of GDP vs a no-measures path (2.8% vs 1.9%); ~0.3pp remains in 2027 before withdrawal. Afi scores RDL 7/2026 alone at EUR 5.5bn deficit impact (0.3% of GDP), mostly VAT and hydrocarbon cuts. The line here is the AIReF temporary package's tax share (~⅔ of ~EUR 12–16bn in 2026)

items.label: 2026 energy response: social bonuses and direct support
items.head: spend
items.event: RDL 7/2026 and subsequent energy RDLs (Middle East price response)
items.source: Remainder of the AIReF temporary package after the tax share: social electricity discount, heating allowance, transport and agriculture diesel support. Temporary; withdrawn through 2027
